topic: The Mechanics of Learning: Cost Functions and Gradient Descent

sections.title: The Learning Objective (Prerequisite)
lecture_lines: Neural networks aim to minimize prediction error.
Parameters are knobs we turn to adjust.
Weights and biases control the network's output.
animations: Display 'Goal: Minimize Error' at the top (#FFFFFF).
Show two variables labeled 'Weight' (#FFCC00) and 'Bias' (#00CCFF).
Animate an archer aiming at a target (#FFFFFF).
Show the arrow hitting away from the center (#FF0000).
Highlight the distance as 'Error' (#FF0000).

sections.title: Defining Failure: The Cost Function
lecture_lines: The cost function measures prediction error.
We represent this as an error landscape.
Low valleys signify high model accuracy.
animations: Display 'Cost Function: Mean Squared Error' at the top (#FFFFFF).
Draw a 3D parabolic 'Error Landscape' (#888888).
Place a dot representing a 'Current Guess' (#FFCC00).
Use a grid (#CCCCCC) to represent input variations.
Highlight the deep valley labeled 'Global Minimum' (#00FF00).

sections.title: The Descent Strategy: Gradient Descent
lecture_lines: Gradient descent is our navigation tool.
The derivative tells us the steepest path.
We follow the slope to reach minima.
animations: Display 'Gradient Descent: Slope' at the top (#FFFFFF).
Show a tangent line on the 'Error Landscape' (#FF0000).
Animate an arrow pointing down the slope (#00CCFF).
Show the 'Current Guess' moving down the slope (#FFCC00).
Emphasize the derivative as the slope direction (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: Dynamics: Learning Rate and Convergence
lecture_lines: Learning rate defines our step size.
Large steps might overshoot the valley.
Small steps may be too slow.
animations: Display 'Learning Rate: Step Size' at the top (#FFFFFF).
Show a small step size leading slowly downward (#00CCFF).
Show a large step size overshooting the valley (#FF0000).
Label the 'Optimal Step' (#00FF00).
Highlight the trade-off: speed vs accuracy (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: Summary and Synthesis
lecture_lines: Iterative loops refine our model's weights.
Predict, calculate cost, and adjust slope.
animations: Display 'The Iterative Learning Loop' (#FFFFFF).
Animate a flow chart: Predict -> Cost -> Gradient -> Adjust.
Highlight each step in the loop sequentially (#00FF00).
Show the 'Current Guess' reaching the valley bottom (#00FF00).
Display 'Learning Complete' (#FFFFFF).
